I'm looking at the excerpt helper first: it always adds an ellipsis, even when the text is already short enough to fit. The word-boundary function also looks off, since it leaves out the character at the limit, so a word that ends exactly there gets cut too early. The test seems to lock in that same behavior, which conflicts with its own name. I'm also noticing that the plain-text conversion strips underscores inside words like snake_case.

I'm also seeing that the markdown cleanup doesn't handle image syntax properly: it leaves a stray "!" behind from the alt text. Since markers are stripped before links, the underscores inside URLs get removed along with the URL, but any underscores in the link text are still affected. I'll run the tests to confirm these.

payload.text:
I reviewed `excerpt-helper` against main (2 commits). All 3 tests pass, but there are two bugs in `excerpt` that break the behaviour the README promises. I'd fix those before merging. I haven't changed anything.

**Blocking**

1. **Every excerpt gets an ellipsis, even when nothing was cut.** `excerpt()` never checks whether the text already fits within the limit, so short text still comes back with "…" on the end:
   - `excerpt('hi', 10)` → `"hi…"`
   - `excerpt('', 5)` → `"…"`

   The README says short text is "returned unchanged" and the ellipsis only appears "when text was actually removed." So most short card bodies would look truncated. It needs an early `if (trimmed.length <= limit) return trimmed;`.

2. **Word-boundary off-by-one in `lastSpaceBefore`.** It only searches `text.slice(0, limit)`, so it never sees a space sitting exactly at position `limit`. When a word ends exactly at the limit, it gets dropped:
   - `excerpt('one two three', 7)` → `"one…"`, though `"one two…"` fits.

   The README says "at or before the limit." The test in `words.test.js` actually asserts this wrong result (it expects `3` for `('one two three', 7)`), so the test needs fixing too. Searching `text.slice(0, limit + 1)` would fix it.

**Worth fixing (not blocking)**

3. **`toPlain` removes underscores inside words.** `my_var_name` becomes `myvarname`, which will hurt code-heavy snippets. The same goes for `*` and `~` used inside text.
4. **`toPlain` misses some common markdown.** Headings keep their `#` (`# Title` stays as is), and images come out as `!img` because the `!` is left behind. The README says "markers removed," so this is incomplete.
5. **Very thin tests.** There's one happy-path test per function. Nothing covers short or empty text, a word ending exactly at the limit, a single long word with no spaces, or images, headings and underscores. Tests for those cases would have caught bugs 1 and 2.

**Minor**
- The CHANGELOG edits the existing 1.4.0 line ("a title and a body" → "a title and body"). Changing a past release note looks unintended.
- Nothing calls `toPlain` before `excerpt` yet. If that's meant to happen in a later change, fine; otherwise the cards won't use it.

The version bump to 1.5.0 and the module layout look fine.
